description: The line plot illustrates the memory consumption (in GB) of five different video understanding models as a function of the number of video frames processed, ranging from 0 to 1000 frames. The x-axis, labeled “Number of Frames,” is linearly scaled from 0 to 1000 with major gridlines at intervals of 200. The y-axis, labeled “Memory (GB),” is linearly scaled from 0 to 400 with major gridlines at intervals of 50. Five models are compared: VideoLLaMB-R (gold line with circle markers), PLLaVA (green line with circle markers), LLaVA-NeXT (cyan line with circle markers), VideoLLaVA (magenta line with circle markers), and an unlabeled red dashed line with circle markers (likely a baseline or reference). VideoLLaMB-R shows the lowest memory usage, starting near 15 GB at 0 frames and rising gradually to approximately 35 GB at 1000 frames. PLLaVA starts near 20 GB and increases to about 75 GB. LLaVA-NeXT begins near 15 GB and climbs to around 145 GB. The unlabeled red dashed line remains nearly flat, hovering just above 20 GB across all frame counts. VideoLLaVA exhibits the steepest growth: starting near 20 GB, it rises to 120 GB at 200 frames, 230 GB at 300 frames, and then sharply increases beyond 400 GB by 350 frames, exceeding the y-axis limit. All lines are solid except the red one, which is dashed.
